scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:ui && node -e "import('node:fs/promises').then(({ chmod }) => chmod('dist/cli/index.js', 0o755))"
scripts.pack:check: npm run clean && npm run build && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.smoke: npm run build && npm run smoke:status:run && npm run smoke:doctor:run && npm run smoke:doctor:json:run && npm run smoke:channels:doctor:json:run && npm run smoke:doctor:fix:run && npm run smoke:chat:run && npm run smoke:onboard:run && npm run smoke:telegram:setup:run && npm run smoke:zalo:setup:run
scripts.smoke:chat: npm run build && npm run smoke:chat:run
scripts.smoke:doctor: npm run build && npm run smoke:doctor:run
scripts.smoke:doctor:json: npm run build && npm run smoke:doctor:json:run
scripts.smoke:channels:doctor:json: npm run build && npm run smoke:channels:doctor:json:run
scripts.smoke:doctor:fix: npm run build && npm run smoke:doctor:fix:run
scripts.smoke:mcp: npm run build && npm run smoke:mcp:run
scripts.smoke:onboard: npm run build && npm run smoke:onboard:run
scripts.smoke:onboard:run:
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d) && cd $tmpdir && printf 'Bestie
Boss
ask
openai-compatible
http://127.0.0.1:9/v1
test-model
test-key
' | HOME=$tmpdir node $INIT_CWD/dist/cli/index.js onboard --skip-provider-test; code=$?; rm -rf $tmpdir; exit $code
scripts.smoke:status: npm run build && npm run smoke:status:run
scripts.smoke:telegram: npm run build && npm run smoke:telegram:run
scripts.smoke:telegram:run: tmpdir=$(mktemp -d) && cd $tmpdir && HOME=$tmpdir node $INIT_CWD/dist/cli/index.js channels telegram 2>&1 | grep -q 'Telegram is not enabled'; code=$?; rm -rf $tmpdir; exit $code
scripts.smoke:telegram:setup: npm run build && npm run smoke:telegram:setup:run
scripts.smoke:zalo: npm run build && npm run smoke:zalo:run
scripts.smoke:zalo:setup: npm run build && npm run smoke:zalo:setup:run
scripts.smoke:tools: npm run build && npm run smoke:tools:run
scripts.smoke:tools:run: node dist/cli/index.js tools logs --lines 5 | grep -q 'action_permission_decision' && node dist/cli/index.js tools memories --limit 5 >/dev/null && node dist/cli/index.js tools git status >/dev/null
scripts.smoke:ui: npm run build && npm run smoke:ui:run
scripts.smoke:ui:all: npm run build && npm run smoke:ui:run && npm run smoke:ui:browser:run && node scripts/smoke-ui-onboarding-browser.mjs
scripts.smoke:ui:browser: npm run build && npm run smoke:ui:browser:run
